name: Eselt – Multichannel Integration: eBay, Amazon & More for WooCommerce
author: eselt

sections.description:
Sell on eBay, Amazon, Kaufland.de, and Otto.de directly from WooCommerce with Eselt – a multichannel connector and eBay & Amazon lister built for WooCommerce. Connect your store once to create, publish, and maintain professional listings on all supported marketplaces, with inventory, prices, and orders kept in sync automatically – all without leaving WordPress. It also includes an AI Listing Assistant that helps you generate and refine product titles and descriptions faster.

Supported Marketplaces

  • eBay: Germany (ebay.de), Austria (ebay.at), United States (ebay.com), United Kingdom (ebay.co.uk), Australia (ebay.com.au)
  • Amazon: United States (amazon.com), Germany (amazon.de), United Kingdom (amazon.co.uk), Australia (amazon.com.au)
  • Kaufland.de
  • Otto.de

WooCommerce eBay Integration

Export your WooCommerce products to eBay (DE, AT, COM, UK, AU) and list them in bulk, manage titles, categories and item specifics per marketplace, and keep stock, prices and orders in sync automatically. The eBay connection is part of Eselt’s multichannel solution, so the same products can go live on Amazon, Kaufland.de and Otto.de too.

WooCommerce Amazon Integration

Turn your WooCommerce products into Amazon listings (COM, DE, UK, AU) and sync inventory, prices and orders between Amazon and your store. Like every Eselt channel, Amazon is managed alongside eBay, Kaufland.de and Otto.de from one central place.

Import eBay and Amazon Listings into WooCommerce

Already selling on eBay or Amazon? Eselt also works as an eBay and Amazon importer: import your existing listings and publish them in your WooCommerce store, then keep stock, prices and orders in sync across all channels.

Features

  1. List and edit multiple listings

    • Bulk create marketplace listings from WooCommerce products.
    • Centralized editor for titles, categories, item specifics/attributes, images, and policies per channel.
    • Quick revise/re‑publish when product details change.

  2. Templates & Profiles for faster listing

    • Reusable Templates for attributes, shipping/return/payment policies, and description layout.
    • Channel‑specific Profiles to speed up eBay, Amazon, Kaufland.de, and Otto.de launches.
    • Update a Template once and apply changes across linked listings.
    • Include eBay description templates to present clean, responsive descriptions.

  3. AI Listing Assistant

    • Draft high‑quality product titles and descriptions in minutes.
    • Optimize tone, length, and keywords per marketplace.
    • Reduce manual copywriting time while keeping brand consistency.

  4. Variations support

    • List variable products (size, color, etc.) as a single multi‑variant listing where supported.
    • List up to 100 variants in minutes.

  5. Order Management & Fulfillment

    • Import orders from eBay, Amazon, Kaufland.de, and Otto.de into WooCommerce automatically.
    • Manage all orders in one place (pick, pack, ship) from your WooCommerce backend.
    • Sync shipment tracking back to marketplaces to keep buyers informed.

  6. Real-time sync

    • Turn on LiveSync to keep product attributes, price, and inventory up to date across channels.

  7. Product safety (GPSR)

    • Keep GPSR data (manufacturer, responsible person in the EU, safety information) with each product.
    • Send it with your listings to the marketplaces that ask for it.
    • Show it on your WooCommerce product page, or hand it over to German Market or Germanized.

WooCommerce Integration in a Few Clicks

Step 1: Install & enable the plugin
– Install and activate the Eselt plugin in WordPress.
– The plugin verifies WooCommerce and prepares a secure connection.
– API credentials are generated automatically.

Step 2: Connect marketplaces
– Set WooCommerce as your Main Store, then connect eBay, Amazon, Kaufland.de, and Otto.de.

Step 3: Prepare listings
– Select products from WooCommerce and configure channel‑specific details (categories, item specifics/attributes, images, prices, policies).
– Use the AI Listing Assistant to propose titles and descriptions.

Step 4: Publish & sync
– Publish to eBay, Amazon, Kaufland.de, and Otto.de in bulk.
– Keep prices and inventory synchronized automatically.

Step 5: Import & fulfill orders
– Eselt pulls marketplace orders into WooCommerce in near real time.
– Fulfill from WooCommerce and send tracking updates back to marketplaces.

See Eselt in Action

Boost Your Sales: Move WooCommerce Products to eBay in Seconds with Eselt

Scale to Amazon Fast: Turn Your WooCommerce Products into Amazon Listings with Eselt

From WooCommerce/eBay/Amazon to Kaufland – The Easiest Method with Eselt

From WooCommerce to Otto.de – Sell Your Products on One of Germany’s Leading Marketplaces with Eselt

External services

This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to the Eselt app (app.eselt.de), a multichannel listing service provided by Eselt. Using it requires an Eselt account. Test all integrations for free for 30 days, with no commitment (see pricing).

Data sent to Eselt:

  • When you click “Connect to Eselt”, the plugin creates WooCommerce REST API keys and sends your store address and these keys to app.eselt.de.
  • Eselt then uses these keys to read and update products, stock, prices and orders in your store through the WooCommerce REST API, including the stock change history recorded by the plugin. It also adds a WooCommerce webhook that notifies app.eselt.de when an order changes.
  • When you deactivate the plugin, it sends your store address and the API consumer key to app.eselt.de, so Eselt stops syncing with your store.

Terms of service, Privacy policy

Minimum requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or newer
  • PHP 7.4 or newer
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or newer
  • Pretty permalinks enabled (the plugin can enable them automatically)
sections.installation:
1. Install the Eselt plugin either directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory or by uploading the plugin ZIP file through WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Open the Eselt page in the admin menu and click Connect to Eselt.
  4. Follow the steps in the Eselt app to finish connecting your store.
sections.faq:
Do I need an Eselt account? How much does it cost?

Yes. The plugin connects your store to the Eselt app, where you create your account while connecting. Test all integrations for free for 30 days, with no commitment. Prices: Eselt pricing.

Can I connect WooCommerce to eBay?

Yes. Eselt connects your WooCommerce store to eBay (DE, AT, COM, UK, AU). You can create eBay listings from your WooCommerce products in bulk and keep stock, prices and orders synchronized.

Can I connect WooCommerce to Amazon?

Yes. Eselt connects WooCommerce to Amazon (COM, DE, UK, AU). Publish your WooCommerce products as Amazon listings and sync inventory, prices and orders automatically.

Can I import my eBay or Amazon listings into WooCommerce?

Yes. Import your existing eBay or Amazon listings into Eselt and send them to your WooCommerce store in bulk. The connector works both ways: from WooCommerce to the marketplaces and from the marketplaces to WooCommerce.

Which other marketplaces can I connect to WooCommerce?

Besides eBay and Amazon, Eselt currently supports Kaufland.de and Otto.de. New sales channels are added over time.

Can I manage multiple marketplaces from one WooCommerce store?

Yes. You connect WooCommerce to Eselt once and manage listings, stock and orders for all connected marketplaces from a single interface.

Does Eselt sync inventory, prices and orders across sales channels?

Yes. With LiveSync enabled, product attributes, prices and inventory stay up to date across all channels, and marketplace orders are imported into WooCommerce for fulfillment.

Does Eselt support GPSR (product safety)?

Yes. Eselt keeps the manufacturer, the responsible person in the EU and safety information with each product and sends them with your listings to the marketplaces that ask for them. In WooCommerce, the plugin shows this data on the product page or passes it to German Market or Germanized.

The connection fails or stops working. What can I do?

Most often a firewall in front of your store blocks requests from Eselt. Please allow our IP addresses 213.133.106.182 and 213.133.105.31:

  • Cloudflare: add both IP addresses under Security > WAF > Tools > IP Access Rules with the action Allow. If that does not help, turn off Bot Fight Mode (Security > Bots). If you use Super Bot Fight Mode or WAF custom rules, add a custom rule (Security > WAF > Custom rules) with the expression “IP Source Address is in 213.133.106.182 213.133.105.31” and the action Skip, with all offered options enabled. Also make sure “I’m Under Attack” mode is off.
  • WordPress security plugins (for example Wordfence, BlogVault, MalCare, Sucuri): add both IP addresses to the plugin’s list of allowed or trusted IP addresses.
  • Hosting provider: some hosts block API requests on their own firewall. Ask your host to allow both IP addresses.

If the connection still fails, contact us and we will check the response from your store.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release with admin UI, requirement checks, permalink setup, API key generation, and Eselt app connection.

1.0.1

  • Improved usability when user is connected to the Eselt app.

1.0.2

  • More screenshots added to plugin page, better banner resolution.

1.0.3

  • Marking new version as stable.

1.0.4

  • Add video to plugin page.

1.1.0

  • Add inventory management for products and variants to enable external marketplace sync

1.3.0

  • Added Seller Central order link for Amazon orders in WooCommerce admin.

1.3.8

  • Added optional “Return tracking number” field to the order edit screen.

1.4.0

  • Product safety (GPSR): manufacturer, responsible person in the EU and safety information transferred by Eselt are now shown on the product page (as a “Product safety” tab, below the summary, or not at all – configurable on the Eselt page) and in a read-only box on the product edit screen. Shops using German Market or Germanized can hand the data over to that plugin’s fields instead.

1.4.2

  • Product safety texts are now translatable on translate.wordpress.org (literal text domain); tested up to WordPress 7.1.

1.4.3

  • Store API keys are sent to the Eselt app in a POST request instead of the URL.

1.4.4

  • German translation is used even when an older language pack from translate.wordpress.org is installed (the product safety settings and the “Product safety” tab were shown in English). Missing texts are still taken from the language pack.
  • German locale variants (Deutsch (Sie), Österreich, Schweiz) use the German translation instead of English.

1.4.5

  • Simpler product safety (GPSR) settings: first choose which plugin shows the data on the product page (Eselt, German Market or Germanized); the display options appear only when Eselt shows the data.
  • Shops without German Market or Germanized can choose one of them and get a link to the plugin; Eselt hands the data over as soon as the plugin is active.
  • Removed the “Apply to all products now” button – the data is handed over to the selected plugin with every product export from Eselt.

1.4.6

  • Stock changes from orders are recorded again in stores with the WooCommerce feature “Cache Product Objects” (enabled automatically in stores installed with WooCommerce 11.0 or later). Before, Eselt did not see sales from such stores and did not reduce the stock.
